description: Verify a multi-chain ERC-20 USDT or USDC transfer (Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, or Ethereum) sent to a job's BIP-44 watch-only deposit_address and unlock the bundle. Use for multi-chain or USDT payments (use calligraphy_verify_crypto_payment for x402 Base USDC treasury transfers). Requires job_id and tx_hash; returns JSON unlocked=True. Example: job_id='job_01', token='USDC', network='base'.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier awaiting on-chain payment unlock.

network.description: EVM settlement network: base, arbitrum, polygon, or ethereum.

token.description: ERC-20 stablecoin symbol transferred ('USDC' or 'USDT', 6 decimals).

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 66-character hexadecimal EVM transaction hash of ERC-20 transfer.

name: calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment
title: Verify On-Chain Stablecoin Payment
